module web.title_length
  purpose: Measure the title of a web page for agents.

import std.http as web

public type PageError is one of
  purpose: Why a page title could not be measured.
  FetchFailed(reason: Text)
  MissingTitle(reason: Text)
  can ToText
end

public function title_length(html: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with PageError
  purpose: Count the characters between the title tags of an HTML document, failing when there is no complete title element.
  tags: html, text
  example: title_length(html: "<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") is 5
  example: title_length(html: "<title></title>") is 0

  let opened be html.split("<title>")
  let after_open be opened.rest().first() otherwise fail with MissingTitle(reason: "the page has no <title> element")
  let closed be after_open.split("</title>")
  if closed.length() is less than 2 then
    fail with MissingTitle(reason: "the <title> element is never closed")
  end
  let title be closed.first() otherwise fail with MissingTitle(reason: "the <title> element is empty or unreadable")
  return title.length()
end

public function page_title_length(url: web.Url)
  returns Integer
  or fails with PageError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download the web page at the given address and return the number of characters in its title element.
  tags: web, title
  expose as tool

  let page be web.get(url) otherwise fail with FetchFailed(reason: "the page could not be downloaded")
  let length be title_length(html: page) otherwise fail
  return length
end

test "the title length is counted"
  check title_length(html: "<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") is 5
end
```

module web.title_tool
  purpose: Expose an agent tool that reports how long a web page's title is.

import std.http as web

public type PageError is one of
  purpose: The ways measuring a page title can fail.
  NoTitle
  UnclosedTitle
  FetchFailed(url: Text)
end

function title_length(html: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with PageError
  purpose: Count the characters in the first title element of an HTML text.
  tags: html, text
  example: title_length("<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") is 5
  example: title_length("<TITLE lang=\"en\">  Home page </TITLE>") is 9

  let lowered be html.to_lower()
  let open_at be lowered.index_of("<title") otherwise fail with NoTitle
  let lowered_rest be lowered.drop(open_at)
  let html_rest be html.drop(open_at)
  let tag_end be lowered_rest.index_of(">") otherwise fail with NoTitle
  let content be html_rest.drop(tag_end + 1)
  let lowered_content be content.to_lower()
  let close_at be lowered_content.index_of("</title") otherwise fail with UnclosedTitle
  let title be content.take(close_at).trim()
  if title.is_empty() then
    fail with NoTitle
  end
  return title.length()
end

public function page_title_length(url: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with PageError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download the web page at the given address and return the number of characters in its title element, failing when the page has no title.
  tags: web, html, title
  expose as tool

  let page be web.get(url) otherwise fail with FetchFailed(url: url)
  return title_length(page)
end

test "the title length ignores surrounding whitespace"
  check title_length("<html><title>  Renyi  </title></html>") is 5
end

module web.title_length
  purpose: Let agents measure the length of a web page's title.

import std.http as web
import std.http exposing Url

public type PageError is one of
  purpose: Why a page title could not be measured.
  FetchFailed(detail: Text)
  NoTitle(detail: Text)
end

public function title_length(html: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with PageError
  purpose: Count the characters of the trimmed text inside the first title element of an HTML document.
  tags: html, text
  example: title_length("<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") is 5
  example: title_length("<TITLE lang=\"en\">  Home page </TITLE>") is 9

  let lowered be html.to_lower()
  let open_start be lowered.index_of("<title") otherwise fail with NoTitle(detail: "the page has no title element")
  let from_open be html.drop(open_start)
  let tag_end be from_open.index_of(">") otherwise fail with NoTitle(detail: "the title tag is never closed with a greater-than sign")
  let content be from_open.drop(tag_end + 1)
  let close_start be content.to_lower().index_of("</title>") otherwise fail with NoTitle(detail: "the title element has no closing tag")
  let title be content.take(close_start).trim()
  if title.is_empty() then
    fail with NoTitle(detail: "the title element is empty")
  end
  return title.length()
end

public function page_title_length(address: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with PageError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download the web page at the given address and return the number of characters in its title element, failing with NoTitle when the page has no title.
  tags: web, html
  expose as tool

  let url be Url(address) otherwise fail with FetchFailed(detail: "not a valid URL: {address}")
  let body: Text be web.get(url) otherwise fail with FetchFailed(detail: "could not download {address}")
  let length be title_length(body) otherwise fail
  return length
end

test "the title length is counted"
  check title_length("<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") is 5
end

test "attributes and surrounding whitespace are ignored"
  check title_length("<TITLE lang=\"en\">  Home page </TITLE>") is 9
end

module page.titles
  purpose: Measure the length of the title of a web page, as a tool for agents.

import std.http as web

public type TitleError is one of
  purpose: Why a page title could not be measured.
  MissingTitle(detail: Text)
  Unreachable(detail: Text)
end

public function title_length(html: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with TitleError
  purpose: Count the characters between the first title tags of an HTML text.
  tags: html, title
  example: title_length("<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") is 5
  example: title_length("<title>A b</title>") is 3

  let parts be html.split("<title>")
  let after be parts.rest().first() otherwise fail with MissingTitle(detail: "the page has no title element")
  let pieces be after.split("</title>")
  if pieces.length() is less than 2 then
    fail with MissingTitle(detail: "the title element is never closed")
  end
  let title be pieces.first() otherwise fail with MissingTitle(detail: "the page has no title element")
  return title.length()
end

public function page_title_length(url: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with TitleError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download the page at the given address and return how many characters its title element holds, failing with MissingTitle when it has none.
  tags: web, html, title
  expose as tool

  let page be web.get(url) otherwise fail with Unreachable(detail: "could not download {url}")
  return title_length(page) otherwise fail
end

test "the title length is counted"
  check title_length("<title>Renyi</title>") is 5
end
